function automatic logic perm_ok(
  input logic r,
  input logic w,
  input logic x,
  input logic u,
  input logic a,
  input logic d,
  input logic is_fetch,
  input logic is_store,
  input logic [1:0] priv,
  input logic sum,
  input logic mxr
);
  logic ok;
  begin
    ok = 1'b1;
    if (!a) ok = 1'b0;
    if (is_store && !d) ok = 1'b0;
    if (priv == 2'b00) begin
      if (!u) ok = 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if (is_fetch) begin
        if (u) ok = 1'b0;
      end else begin
        if (u && !sum) ok = 1'b0;
      end
    end
    if (is_fetch) begin
      if (!x) ok = 1'b0;
    end else if (is_store) begin
      if (!w) ok = 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if (!(r || (mxr && x))) ok = 1'b0;
    end
    perm_ok = ok;
  end
endfunction
